resources.string: Sends the charge, power, speed and position to A Better Routeplanner over the car\'s own internet connection (T-box), so ABRP plans from the real battery level. About every 10 s while driving, less when parked. Uses the car\'s mobile data.
In the ABRP app: your car\'s settings, Live data, then Generic. Copy the token shown there.
Identifies DiAuto to ABRP. Leave it as it is unless you use your own telemetry key. If ABRP often refuses the data, create your own free telemetry key at abetterrouteplanner.com/resources/api.
